verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide has its own section on event notifications and subscriptions, which is the product's own mechanism for pushing events to developer systems. However, the evidence is only a section title: it never confirms delivery as registrable outbound HTTP webhooks, nor that call and message events specifically are covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook (HTTP callback) delivery and registration, confirmation that call and SMS/message event types are available, payload and retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: Introduction to event notifications and subscriptions
